description: List Hugging Face datasets with keyword search, sort order, and author filtering. sort is trending (default, 趋势) | likes (点赞最多) | downloads (下载最多) | created (最新创建) | modified (最近更新), internally mapped to the API tokens trendingScore/likes/downloads/createdAt/lastModified; search filters by keyword (对应 /datasets?search=); author lists one user/organization's datasets (对应 /datasets?author=). Dataset-specific dimensions (language/size_categories) are carried in each item's tags, not as separate parameters. Returns ranked items with id, url, likes, downloads, trendingScore, tags, created/updated dates. Reads HF's internal API via page-internal fetch from the browser; no login required.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Keyword search within datasets (URL ?search=).（在数据集索引内按关键词过滤，对应 /datasets 搜索框。）

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: trending (default, 趋势) | likes (点赞最多) | downloads (下载最多) | created (最新创建) | modified (最近更新). Internally mapped to the API values trendingScore/likes/downloads/createdAt/lastModified.（排序方式，默认 trending 即 HF 趋势榜。）

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: List all datasets by one author/organization (URL ?author=).（列出某作者/组织发布的所有数据集。）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum datasets to return (a plain positive integer, 1-100, default 20). Non-integer strings such as 1.5/1e3/2abc are rejected. （返回条数上限，纯正整数 1-100，默认 20。非法字符串一律报错。）
